record.name: BigCommerce
record.one_liner: An open SaaS ecommerce platform and API suite for managing stores, products, orders, and customer data.
record.access_note: Sign up for a free trial store or use the developer portal to create API credentials and trial accounts.
record.api_note: Covers product catalogs, orders, customers, storefront operations, webhooks, and store settings.

evidence.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers
Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
Use REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically.
connect to the MCP server at https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server.

evidence_checks.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers

auth.why: Docs only mention OAuth‑based accounts; no evidence for api_key or token methods.

access.why: Docs state you can sign up for a free trial store to test APIs.

mcp.why: Official docs give the MCP server URL at https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server.

verdict.why: Auth claim is false, so overall verdict cannot be yes.
